description: This file contains prototype declarations for exported functions of the Dslh DataModelAgent component, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization functions. It serves as an external API interface for Dslh DataModelAgent in a broadband or device management system.

methods.name: DslhCreateDataModelAgent
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new DataModelAgent object, accepting container, owner, and reserved context handles.

methods.name: DslhDmagntCreate
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new DataModelAgent object with specified contexts.

methods.name: DslhDmagntRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the DataModelAgent object associated with the provided handle.

methods.name: DslhDmagntEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrols required internal objects within the DataModelAgent object.
